# Dr. Shikha Gupta — Consultant Paediatrician & Child Clinic

> Consultant Paediatrician and Child Specialist based in Kamla Nagar, North Delhi. MBBS (VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital), MD Pediatrics (Dr. RML Hospital / PGIMER). Providing evidence-based, compassionate care with an emphasis on unhurried consultations, rational medication, certified vaccine cold-chain management, and continuous parental guidance.

## Core Paediatric Clinical Services

### 1. Well-Baby Care & Infant Health Checkups
* **URL:** https://drshikhagupta.com/services/well-baby-care
* **Target Age Group:** Newborns and infants from 0 to 12 months.
* **Scope:** Systematic head-to-toe neonatal examination, fontanelle assessment, eye and abdominal screening, WHO-standardized weight, length, and head circumference plotting, feeding and burping guidance, and early milestone monitoring.

### 2. Child Vaccination & Immunisation Guidance
* **URL:** https://drshikhagupta.com/services/vaccination
* **Scope:** Doctor-administered childhood immunisations adhering strictly to Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) and National Immunisation Schedules. Includes pre-vaccine physical checkup, certified medical cold-chain vaccine storage (2°C to 8°C), post-vaccine fever management guidance, and personalized catch-up schedules for delayed or missed doses.

### 3. Child Growth & Developmental Milestone Tracking
* **URL:** https://drshikhagupta.com/services/growth-development
* **Scope:** WHO percentile growth charting, tracking physical height and weight trajectories, gross motor, fine motor, speech, language, and social-emotional milestone screening. Early detection and structured intervention plans for developmental delays.

### 4. Childhood Illness & Acute Sickness Consultation
* **URL:** https://drshikhagupta.com/services/childhood-illness
* **Scope:** Attentive clinical evaluation and management of common pediatric ailments including fever, respiratory infections (croup, bronchitis, cough), stomach bugs, viral illnesses, ear infections, skin rashes, and seasonal allergies.
* **Clinical Principle:** Rational medication stewardship with zero polypharmacy. Antibiotics are strictly prescribed only when clinically warranted by bacterial infection; never for routine viral upper respiratory infections.

### 5. Adolescent Care & Teenage Health Consultations
* **URL:** https://drshikhagupta.com/services/adolescent-care
* **Target Age Group:** Older children and teenagers aged 11 to 18 years.
* **Scope:** Growth spurts, pubertal changes, teenage nutritional guidance (iron, calcium), posture and spine evaluation, screen time and sleep hygiene, adolescent stress, and booster immunisations (HPV, Tdap).

### 6. Parental Guidance & Child Care Counselling
* **URL:** https://drshikhagupta.com/services/parental-counselling
* **Scope:** Partnering with parents through practical child-rearing challenges: toddler sleep training, fussy eating habits, toddler tantrums, positive discipline strategies, and transition to preschool.

### 7. Breastfeeding Support & Lactation Counselling
* **URL:** https://drshikhagupta.com/services/breastfeeding-support
* **Scope:** Compassionate maternal and infant feeding support: correcting latch and position, assessing milk transfer, managing engorgement and nipple soreness, infant reflux guidance, and gentle complementary feeding transitions around 6 months.

---

## Clinical Philosophy & Medical Principles

1. **Evidence-Based Medicine:** All treatment protocols adhere to established clinical guidelines by the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) and global pediatric bodies.
2. **Rational Medication & Antibiotic Stewardship:** Dr. Gupta believes in minimizing medication burden on young bodies. Simple viral colds, coughs, and gastroenteritis are managed with supportive care, hydration, and safe fever protocols rather than reflexive antibiotics.
3. **Unhurried Consultations:** Every family receives dedicated consultation time so parents can ask questions without feeling rushed and leave with actionable clarity.
4. **Certified Vaccine Cold-Chain:** All biologicals and vaccines are maintained in dedicated medical refrigeration units with continuous temperature monitoring (2°C to 8°C).
5. **Emergency Disclaimer:** The clinic operates on an outpatient basis. Routine visits and online requests are not suitable for acute, life-threatening medical emergencies (e.g. severe breathing difficulty, seizures, loss of consciousness, persistent lethargy). Caregivers are advised to visit the nearest hospital casualty emergency room directly.
